value.rationale: Complete natural classification of all rank-two subgroups in the canonical 16-element sign group connects quotient singularity baskets and anti-canonical degrees to smooth-locus fundamental groups and universal quasi-etale covering structures. Such cover data distinguishes the six-nodal degree-one stratum from degree-four nodal quotients and informs singular del Pezzo classification; the all-35 classification, rather than an arbitrarily chosen slice, is the mathematical object.
